_comment: Kairos Crypto Risk Configuration — Phase B. Edit thresholds here; no code changes needed.

position_limits._comment: Max fraction of total portfolio value in any single crypto asset (5% default)

trade_limits._comment: Max USD value per single crypto trade ($500 default)

circuit_breaker._comment: Halt ALL crypto trading if BTC or ETH moves more than price_move_pct% in window_hours

daily_loss_limit._comment: Stop trading crypto for the day if unrealized+realized crypto P&L < -max_loss_pct% of crypto portfolio value

trading_window._comment: All times in Eastern Time (ET). DST handled automatically by the scheduler.

_comment_ibkr: Only BTC/ETH available on IBKR via Paxos. SOL/BNB/XRP decisions logged but not executed.
_comment2: How many hours of price history to retain for the circuit breaker window check

signals._comment: HOT-REVERSION: 24h drop >3%. HOT-RSI: RSI<30. HOT-CRYPTO-MOMENTUM: 4h gain >3%. HOT-CRYPTO-MACRO: fear/greed >50. HOT-CRYPTO-BASELINE: BTC > 7d SMA.

confluence._comment: 5 signals possible (max 6pts). NLV-based sizing: 0.5%-1.5% of NLV. At $1M: $5K-$15K. base_trade_usd is fallback cap.
